name: TC-177: a gift card that fully covers the order completes without a Stripe step
description: A gift card funded well above the order total covers the whole charge: the checkout places the order without asking for a card and lands on 'Order Confirmed!', and the card's balance drops by the order total.

steps.name: Seed a gift card worth far more than the order
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "AUTOGCMVQRLRXUWELTUN" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
The card paid the whole order: its balance dropped by the total
